Configuration reference

Widget reads its settings from a file named widget.config.json in the project root. Every key is optional; anything you leave out falls back to the default shown below.

timeout

How long, in milliseconds, a request may take before it is cancelled. The default is 8000. Values below 100 are rejected when the file is loaded.

retries

How many times a failed request is tried again. Retries use exponential backoff starting at 250 milliseconds.

{ "timeout": 8000, "retries": 2 }
